meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 帮你把 cmem.ai 的 sync token、user id、SyncHub URL 写进 claude-mem 插件配置，让 hooks 能捕获并注入记忆。它会从你粘贴的 Connect 信息里提取这三个值，写好后跑一次状态检查并只报告打码结果。
howto.when: 当你要求「set up claude-mem」「connect cmem」，或直接粘贴 cmem.ai 的 Connect 凭据时接管，配置这个插件的凭据。

say.text: 帮我设置 claude-mem，这是我的 cmem Connect 信息
say.note: 提取三个值并写入插件 config.json

say.text: 我的 sync token 是 cm_xxx，帮我配上
say.note: 缺其他两项时会先问你要 token

say.text: 帮我让这次配对永久生效
say.note: 把插件目录打包成 .plugin 交给你重装

howto.what_en: Writes your cmem.ai sync token, user id and SyncHub URL into the claude-mem plugin config so its hooks can capture and inject memory. It extracts those three values from the Connect info you paste, then runs a status check and reports only the masked output.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask to "set up claude-mem", "connect cmem", or paste your cmem.ai Connect credentials, and configures this plugin's credentials.

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem, here is my cmem Connect info
say_en.note: Extracts the values into the plugin config.json

say_en.text: My sync token is cm_xxx, configure it for me
say_en.note: Asks for the token if others are missing

say_en.text: Make this pairing permanent for me
say_en.note: Zips the plugin as a .plugin for reinstall
